# dsh-infer-kit
**Inference toolkit for DeepSeek Harness — semantic cache, draft cascade, and JSON validation.**
Three model-agnostic tools (work with any provider DSH routes to):
| Tool | What it does |
| `infer_cache_lookup` | Semantic cache for answers and tool results. Jaccard similarity ≥ 0.62 trig

gers a hit. Retention: agent = 3 days, chatbot = 7 days. |
| `infer_draft_cascade` | Cheap-draft → e
xpensive-verify cascade (client-side analog of speculative decoding). Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint

works. |
| `infer_json_validate` | Validate JSON against JSON Schema before presenting structured o
utput. Supports type, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, enum, min/max, minLength/ma
ports type, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, enum, min/max, minLength/maxLength. |
Built on ideas from DeepInfer (DeepSeek's open-source inference engine, Apache 2.0, October 2026).
